prompt.project_info: Create a nostalgic early-2000s compact digital-camera photograph showing an adult woman's portrait on the camera screen.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman shown on the screen of a compact digital camera, with long dark hair falling across part of her face in loose strands and a soft, slightly open-lip neutral expression. Use the attached face reference only for an approved adult identity and preserve facial structure.
prompt.composition_elements: Close-up of the camera body surrounding the image, with buttons, dials, textured surface, FUNC/SET wheel, DISP button, and existing IMAGE STABILIZER label visible. The screen image shows the woman indoors at night with a dim cluttered kitchen, appliances, shelves, and metallic surfaces softly blurred. No text or logos inside the photo preview itself.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright built-in flash creates sharp highlights on face and hair against low ambient kitchen light, cool muted undertones, strong flash contrast, authentic display glow and natural grain, candid raw nostalgic mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 4:5 vertical screen composition, compact digital-camera simulation, equivalent 28–35mm lens, f/2.8, ISO 400, 1/60 shutter with flash, auto-flash white balance, nostalgic digital-camera color grade.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Close-up photograph of an approved adult woman displayed on the screen of a compact Canon digital camera. The camera body surrounds the image with its buttons, dials, textured surface, FUNC/SET wheel, DISP button, and existing IMAGE STABILIZER label visible. The screen shows the woman indoors at night, illuminated by a bright built-in flash that creates sharp highlights on her face and long dark hair falling across part of her face in loose strands. She has a soft neutral expression. Behind her is a dim cluttered kitchen with appliances, shelves, and metallic surfaces softly blurred. Early-2000s compact digital-camera snapshot, candid raw nostalgic mood, slightly muted cool undertones, strong flash contrast, natural display grain and screen glow, 4:5 vertical ratio, equivalent 28–35mm lens, f/2.8, ISO 400, 1/60 with flash, no text or logos inside the photo preview.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, celebrity likeness, identity drift, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, blurry, low quality, distorted features, bad anatomy, extra limbs, extra fingers, deformed, invented camera labels, altered screen perspective, watermark
